spans.s: शुध् vi. 4P (pp. शुद्ध; pres. शुध्यति) 1. To become pure, to be purified, निरस्य तु पुमान् शुक्रमुपस्पृश्यैव शुध्यति M.v.63, नदी वेगेन शुध्यति v.108, 2. to be made clear, to have doubts removed.With परि-, वि-, or सम्-, to be purified, M.v.66.
शुध् Caus. (शोधयति) 1. to purify; 2. to pay off (as a debt).
सुधन्वन् (I) a. Having an excellent bow.
सुधन्वन् (II) m. 1. A good archer, a good bowman; 2. a name of Viśvakarman.
सुधन्वन्-आचार्य m. the son of an outcast Vaiśya by a woman of the same class, M.x.23.
सुधर्मन् f. The assembly or council of gods, (स्यात् सुधर्मा देवसभा Am.i.1.51).
सुधर्मन् f. The assembly or council of gods, (स्यात् सुधर्मा देवसभा Am.i.1.51).
सुधर्मन् f. The assembly or council of gods, (स्यात् सुधर्मा देवसभा Am.i.1.51).
सुधा f. 1. The beverage of the gods, nectar, सुधासौंदर्यं ते सलिलमशिवं नः शमयतु G.

; 2. the nectar or honey of flowers; 3. juice; 4. water; 5. a name of the Ganges; 6. whitewash, plaster, mortar, कालांतरश्यामसुधेषु नक्तम् … हर्म्येषु R.xvi.18; 7. a brick; 8. lightning; 9. the milk-hedge plant.
सुधा-अंशु ??? 1. the moon; 2. camphor.
सुधा-अंशु˚रत्न n. a pearl.
सुधा-जीविन् m. a bricklayer.
सुधा-द्रव m. a nectar-like fluid.
सुधा-धवलित a. white-washed.
सुधा-निधि m. 1. the moon; 2. camphor.
सुधा-भवन n. a stuccoed house.
सुधा-भित्ति f. 1. a plastered wall; 2. a brick-wall; 3. the fifth Muhūrta or hour after noon.
सुधा-भुज् m. a god, a deity.
सुधा-भृति m. 1. the moon; 2. sacrifice, oblation.
सुधा-मय n. a royal palace.
सुधा-वर्ष m. a shower of nectar.
सुधा-वर्षिन् m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
सुधा-वास m. 1. the moon; 2. camphor.
सुधा-वासा f. a kind of cucumber.
सुधा-सित a. 1. white as mortar; 2. bright as nectar; 3. bound by nectar, जगतीशरणे युक्तो हरिकांतः सुधासितः Kir.xv.45.
सुधा-सूति m. 1. the moon; 2. a sacrifice; 3. a lotus.
सुधा-स्यंदिन् a. mellifluous.
सुधा-स्रवा f. uvula or soft palate.
सुधा-हर m. an epithet of Garuḍa.
सुधिति f. An axe.
सुधी (I) a. Having a good understanding, wise, clover.
सुधी (II) m. A wise or intelligent man, a paṇḍit.
सुधी (III) f. A good understanding, good sense, intelligence.
सुधी-उपास्य (I) m. 1. a particular kind of royal palace; 2. name of an attendant on Kṛṣṇa.
सुधी-उपास्य (II) n. the club of Balarāma.
सुधी-उपास्या f. 1. a woman; 2. name of one of Umā’s female companions; 3. a sort of pigment.
सुधूम m. A kind of metre.
